name: power of the word

attributes.attribute: the spoken or chanted word carried force

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The power of the word is a concept in Celtic belief. The entry is a cross-reference. The full account appears under POETRY. In Celtic tradition the spoken word carried force. Satire and praise shaped a person's standing. A poet's words could wound or bless. The entry directs the reader to POETRY for the full account of this power.

okr.objective: Point the reader to poetry for the power of the spoken word.
